{{Quote|We used to jest that he was half rancor.|Halliava Vurse on Dasan|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
'''Dasan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] who was resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Dasan was a tall warrior and part of the [[Broken Columns Clan]], a tribe composed of men.<ref name="Backlash" />

Under the leadership of [[Tasander Dest]], the [[Hapan]]-born founder of the Broken Columns Clan, the clan befriended the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], which was comprised of traditionalist [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]]. The Broken Columns Clan was the only tribe of men that did not attack the Raining Leaves Clan shortly after the [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|massacre]] that befell their clan. The two tribes developed a custom where every [[Standard year/Legends|year]] they would convene near [[Redgill Lake]] and form [[Marriage/Legends|marriages]] that lasted a year.<ref name="Backlash" />

[[Halliava Vurse]], the chief trainer of scouts for the Raining Leaves Clan, told [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] that she married Dasan in [[37 ABY]] during their conclave and later gave birth to [[Aradasa Vurse]]. Dasan died a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the conclave when he fell from a tree while plundering nests of their [[Egg/Legends|eggs]].<ref name="Backlash" />
